run_pretrain_model: run the pretraining loop for a CAPI model using a YAML config file path as the argument
run_train_loop: run the main training loop with FSDP distributed training, gradient scaling, and selective checkpointing
run_do_student: run the student forward pass to compute the prediction loss against teacher targets
run_do_teacher: run the teacher forward pass to generate clustering targets and compute clustering loss
run_launch_evals: run evaluation jobs by saving checkpoints and launching benchmark scripts for downstream tasks
